agent.name: Emerging Technology Adoption Agent
agent.specialty: SubAgent 5 bounded contextual adoption posture and evidence-triggered reassessment

analytical_question: Which single adoption posture is justified for this application in this organization now, and what evidence or changed condition should trigger a different action?
general_et_finding: S1 supports heterogeneous agent deployment and selective scaling within its dated respondent sample, not a uniform maturity or adopter stage for all agentic AI. Forty percent and 22% concern revenue subgroups scaling agents in at least one function, not chart-review peers or local value. Under C1, some operational segments may resemble leading edge, but an entire-technology bleeding/leading/commodity/trailing label is unresolved; calendar age and 16% are insufficient tests. General capability evidence does not grant local permission. S2/S3 support context-sensitive evaluation and continuing controls, not certification or a finding that this application is ready.
application_finding: Under fictional H3, the adequate deterministic comparator defeats this agent option on complete effort and false corrections. Manual 100×30 = 3,000 minutes/month; deterministic 100×20 = 2,000; agent 100×(3+12+7)+300 = 2,500. The agent is 500 minutes/month worse than the best adequate baseline, despite being 500 better than manual. The 300 monthly minutes are future support/maintenance; a separate past 300-minute learning exercise is excluded as sunk effort. These are hypothetical effort proxies; financial prices and ROI are unknown.
organization_specific_finding: The primary action is REJECT_FOR_PRESENT for this agent option under H3, while retaining the adequate deterministic alternative. The agent loses to that baseline on complete effort and false corrections; being better than manual drafting alone is not enough. Enthusiasm and the prior 300-minute sunk investment do not repair incremental disadvantage. H3 is a fictional numerical control, not observed performance or financial ROI.

evidence.claim: Separate general, application and organization readings; distinguish bleeding/leading/commodity/trailing edge; choose adopt, experiment, proof of concept, monitor, defer or reject.
evidence.source_or_reference: C1 course://Slides/ET 7 Classification and Adoption Strategie FA26.pptx
evidence.notes: Age bands and the chasm are teaching heuristics. They are not a measured market stage or permission to skip local value, risk and readiness checks.

evidence.claim: Agent scaling reported by 40% of the above-USD1bn revenue subgroup and 22% of the smaller subgroup; 1,719 participants in 97 nations, country-GDP weighting.
evidence.notes: Respondent self-report across functions, not all firms, chart review or a comparable finance-peer denominator. Case revenue unknown. This supplies no local ROI or November field observation.

evidence.claim: Use an appropriate baseline, context-specific risk tolerance, documented evaluation and continuing risk management.
evidence.notes: Voluntary, non-sector-specific guidance. It prescribes neither this case threshold nor permission, regulatory compliance or an adoption decision.

evidence.claim: Check capability claims empirically, document limits and source provenance, and plan monitoring and incident response.
evidence.notes: Suggested actions, not certification. Narrow or anecdotal tests cannot establish general reliability. This report does not rely on the historical executive order as a current legal requirement.

evidence.claim: The relevant case scope, permission and any stipulated outcomes are teaching premises, not observed organizational results.
evidence.evidence_type: Hypothetical case facts for qualitative testing
evidence.notes: No real permission, pilot, peer sample, regulatory conclusion or company benefit is asserted.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Earlier safe learning could avoid unnecessary delay; a conservative preference must not become permanent refusal to investigate.
Unknown peer stage is not proof of absence; general scaling is not local readiness or value.
All company permissions and H1/H2/H3 outcomes are fictional test premises. No real chart-review system or organizational pilot was run.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate for the bounded dated external observations and framework interpretation; low for actual local advantage and readiness. High confidence only in the conditional decision distinction and arithmetic, not in invented field performance. Posture does not change factual confidence.
value_opportunity_implication: Establish incremental benefit over the best adequate comparator at equivalent acceptable quality. Include complete review/correction and support effort plus actual monetary costs when known; time savings are not cash ROI.
risk_governance_implication: A recommendation is not authority to act. Keep read-only scope, permitted data and named human release; stop on unauthorized access, material false claims or lost provenance. The next specialist assesses organizational absorption and sustainment; qualified humans determine applicable legal/data requirements.
recommendation_management_implication: REJECT_FOR_PRESENT — Retain the adequate deterministic alternative for this scope. Reopen only if the agent supplies a needed capability or demonstrably improves equivalent-quality total effort/cost without unacceptable risk. Sunk work and popularity do not count as incremental value; no financial ROI is asserted. Organizational Adoption receives the comparator and cost assumptions.
change_monitoring_triggers: Proposed reporting owner collects dated matched peer outcomes and baseline effort/quality; review within 21 days or earlier on a material new fact.

Replace the primary monitoring posture with a capped PoC only when the permitted scope, learning question and the organization’s evidence preference support it. A favorable PoC can justify a shadow experiment, not automatic deployment.

Require representative sustained comparator results, approved access, accepted residual risk and a supplied Organizational Adoption readiness assessment before staged routine use. Suspend or reject if the adequate simpler option dominates, permission is withdrawn or material errors occur.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Request exact application scope when absent; never infer it from an earlier assignment.
Request measured quality/full cost and the separate readiness/approval assessment before a real rollout; no current regulatory or vendor certification is assumed.
